Line: repro / opt / infra / docs (delete the ones that do not apply)

## What
One or two sentences: what this PR changes.

## Why
Why: which problem, report or decision (with a link).

## How
Key points of the approach. For the reproduction line, state whether a deviation is introduced.

## Evidence
How we know it is right: test commands and results, run_id, evaluation protocol id, numbers or links to figures. Write "not tested" where nothing was tested.
